items.desc_zh: 自帕顿八月下旬去世以来，数十首人工智能生成的歌曲、图像和视频出现在网上。

items.title_en: Far-right AfD landslide in German state piles pressure on federal government
items.title_zh: 德国极右翼选择党在各州取得压倒性胜利给联邦政府带来压力
items.desc_en: The "extraordinary" result may be the "most consequential German state-election result of the postwar era," according to analysts.
items.desc_zh: 分析人士称，这一“非同寻常”的结果可能是“战后最重要的德国州选举结果”。

items.title_en: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill nine
items.title_zh: 以色列对黎巴嫩南部村庄的袭击造成九人死亡
items.desc_en: Lebanon says a recent Israeli escalation is jeopardising a US-brokered ceasefire meant to end the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.
items.desc_zh: 黎巴嫩表示，以色列最近的升级行动正在危及美国斡旋的停火协议，该停火协议旨在结束以色列和真主党之间的冲突。

items.title_en: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
items.title_zh: 德国极右翼选择党表示“民主要求”政党在州选举获胜后与他们合作
items.desc_en: The far-right party is trying to form a government in the state after falling three seats short of a majority.
items.desc_zh: 极右翼政党在距离多数席位仅差三个席位后正试图在该州组建政府。

items.title_en: Nepal observes national day of mourning for victims of flash flood disaster
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔为山洪灾害受害者举行全国哀悼日
items.desc_en: Flags flew at half mast on the 13th day since the disaster, the last day of the Hindu mourning period.
items.desc_zh: 灾难发生后的第13天，印度教哀悼期的最后一天，全国降半旗。

items.title_en: Kyiv air raid alerts at record high as Russia launches round-the-clock strikes
items.title_zh: 俄罗斯全天候空袭基辅空袭警报创历史新高
items.desc_en: Schools, businesses and public transport are all struggling with the surge in Russian air attacks.
items.desc_zh: 学校、企业和公共交通都在应对俄罗斯空袭的激增。

items.title_en: Indonesia volcano eruption leaves 270,000 stranded as airports extend closure
items.title_zh: 印尼火山喷发导致27万人滞留 机场延长关闭时间
items.desc_en: Anak Krakatau, which lies about 150km from the capital Jakarta, began erupting late on Friday.
items.desc_zh: 距离首都雅加达约 150 公里的喀拉喀托火山于周五晚间开始喷发。

items.title_en: Data centers in space: Four big obstacles and Elon Musk's ambitious timeline
items.title_zh: 太空数据中心：四大障碍和埃隆·马斯克雄心勃勃的时间表

items.title_en: Austria's Islamic headscarf ban in force as under-14s go back to school
items.title_zh: 奥地利14岁以下儿童重返校园之际，伊斯兰头巾禁令生效
items.desc_en: The government says the law is intended to protect the rights of young girls, but critics say it is fuelling anti-Muslim feeling.
items.desc_zh: 政府表示，该法律旨在保护年轻女孩的权利，但批评人士称，该法律正在助长反穆斯林情绪。
